roster.name: First 60 satellites
roster.note: a single Falcon 9 deploys 60 flat-packed satellites at once — the operational constellation begins, and the night sky gets its first Starlink 'train'

roster.name: Service goes live
roster.note: public beta opens; a constellation becomes a consumer internet service reaching places fibre and cell towers never did

roster.name: Ukraine
roster.note: Starlink terminals keep a country online through a war — and make one company's constellation a factor in national security overnight

roster.name: Direct to cell
roster.note: satellites begin connecting ordinary phones directly, with no terminal — the constellation starts to become a global cell tower
